text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] GPU pool 'us-west-2-gpu' at 97% utilization -> queue growing. thread_root=2117659012. paging sara_oncall
sara_oncall: on it. joining bridge in 1m. need metrics link and stack trace of recent preempts
infra-bot: grafana: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/GPUPool/usw2?from=now-1h
ops_paul: enqueue rate ~610 req/min, queued tokens 21,400, autoscaler wanted +12 nodes but capped by pool_max=50
kevin_infra: provider responding with "InsufficientInstanceCapacity" for requested shapes and we're hitting EC2 API throttling on describe/allocate
maria_sre: FYI @customer_success_amy — some realtime requests are 504'ing. rough estimate 12-18% customer impact
customer_success_amy: posting to customers.now: prepping a brief note. who owns SLA decisions?
sara_oncall: mitigation plan: 1) pause low-priority batch and offline evals, 2) route new realtime traffic to fallback region (us-east-1), 3) spin up dedicated non-spot nodes for enterprise workloads, 4) enable aggressive prefix caching and quantized fallbacks
ops_paul: pausing batches now:
```
# disable batch consumers
kubectl scale deployment batch-consumer --replicas=0 -n inference-usw2
```
kevin_infra: updating routing rule to prefer us-east fallback for realtime:
```
PATCH /v1/routing
{ "scope": "realtime", "order": ["us-east-1-gpu","us-west-2-gpu"] }
```
infra-bot: quota increase request submitted for reserved_dedicated=4 in us-west-2, ticket Q-1302
maria_sre: dedicated nodes launching (2/4) - 3-5m boot time expected. also enabling cache config
kevin_infra: pushing runtime config for prefix cache and lower-temp TTLs:
```
PATCH /v1/runtime/config
{"prefix_cache":{"enabled":true,"ttl":300}}
```
sara_oncall: also apply model fallback for non-enterprise: route to gpt-q4_legacy in us-east-1 to drop cost/latency
ops_paul: applied. queue snapshot: 21.4k -> 6.2k in 11m
kevin_infra: cloud support escalated. adding jitter + backoff to autoscaler reconcilers to avoid triggering provider throttle
incident-bot: bridge join: zoom.us/j/99988877 passcode=redwood. incident created INC-211765
sara_oncall: scheduling handoff to kevin_infra at 2117659400 UTC for 120m. I'll remain available for questions.
kevin_infra: taking over. will monitor for 30m, confirm provider response, and coordinate with eng-runtime if cold-start latencies spike
maria_sre: marking postmortem flag: tag=gpu-exhaust-211765. capturing logs from inference, autoscaler, and provider responses
customer_success_amy: sent 10m update to customers; one enterprise asked for root-cause and timeline - logged
ops_paul: re-enable batches gradually once queue <1k and p95 <800ms. playbook note added to #incidents: gpu-capacity-surge-playbook
kevin_infra: confirmed no more preempt notices in last 6m. queue trending down 6.2k -> 900. keeping P1 until stable 20m
incident-bot: incident update saved. incident_id=INC-211765
sara_oncall: handoff complete at 2117659400. will draft RCA and timeline after incident closure.
